title_hi: अनिवार्य घोषणाओं को बदलने वाले कोई स्टिकर नहीं
requirement: No stickers altering mandatory declarations; lower-MRP stickers allowed only if original is not covered.
check_method: Second-MRP detection & sticker edge discontinuity heuristic
fix_hint: Print lower price or reprint packaging without obscuring original MRP.

title_en: No different MRPs for identical pre-packaged commodity
title_hi: समान पैकेज्ड वस्तु के लिए अलग-अलग एमआरपी नहीं
requirement: Dual MRP prohibited across retail outlets for identical products.
check_method: Cross-scan match on brand, generic name and net quantity
fix_hint: Standardize MRP across all distribution channels.

title_hi: अक्षर की चौड़ाई और ऊंचाई का अनुपात नियम
requirement: Width of numeral/letter must be >= 1/3 height (except numeral 1, i, I, l).
check_method: Glyph aspect ratio from character segmentation
fix_hint: Use standard non-condensed font family for PDP text.

title_en: Clear space around net quantity declaration
title_hi: शुद्ध मात्रा घोषणा के आसपास स्पष्ट स्थान
requirement: Clear space around net quantity: >= 1x numeral height above/below, >= 2x left/right.
fix_hint: Maintain minimum 1x height breathing room around net quantity numerals.

title_hi: घोषणाएं स्पष्ट और प्रमुख होनी चाहिए
requirement: All mandatory declarations must be legible, prominent and easily readable.
check_method: OCR confidence + Laplacian blur score thresholding
fix_hint: Increase font contrast and print resolution.

title_en: Numeral and letter contrast against background
title_hi: पृष्ठभूमि के खिलाफ संख्या और अक्षर का अंतर
requirement: MRP and net quantity numerals must contrast significantly with background.
check_method: Otsu thresholding luminance contrast ratio inside bbox
fix_hint: Use dark ink on light background or light ink on dark container.

title_en: Readability through outer wrapper and liquid
title_hi: बाहरी आवरण और तरल के माध्यम से पठनीयता
requirement: Declarations must not be obscured by liquid or unprinted outer wrappers.
fix_hint: Ensure outer wrapper carries declarations if inner container is obscured.

requirement: Wholesale packages require manufacturer name/address, identity and count/quantity.
fix_hint: Mark package clearly as WHOLESALE and declare total inner count.

requirement: Declarations on main pack must detail individual contents of accompanying packs.
fix_hint: List contents and net weight/volume of each internal piece.

requirement: Digital marketplace listings must display all Rule 6(1) declarations before purchase.
check_method: Listing text and product image scraper parser
fix_hint: Populate mandatory LMPC attribute fields on e-commerce catalog.

title_en: E-commerce MRP vs Net Qty font parity in advertisements
title_hi: विज्ञापन में एमआरपी बनाम शुद्ध मात्रा का फ़ॉन्ट आकार
requirement: Advertisements quoting MRP must show net quantity in same font size.
check_method: Rendered text bounding box height comparison
fix_hint: Ensure net quantity font size equals or exceeds MRP font size in ads.

title_en: Net quantity deficiency within Maximum Permissible Error (MPE)
title_hi: अधिकतम स्वीकार्य त्रुटि (MPE) के भीतर शुद्ध मात्रा की कमी
requirement: Net quantity error must not exceed First Schedule MPE limits.
check_method: MPE calculation against declared net weight/volume
fix_hint: Adjust filling equipment calibration to eliminate short-weight packages.

title_en: Lot sampling inspection and statutory Form A/B testing
title_hi: लॉट नमूना निरीक्षण और वैधानिक फॉर्म ए/बी परीक्षण
requirement: Statistical lot inspection (32 or 80 samples) and tare correction procedure.
fix_hint: Conduct regular batch sampling in plant laboratory before dispatch.

title_en: GTIN, Barcode and QR code verification
title_hi: जीटीआईएन, बारकोड और क्यूआर कोड सत्यापन
requirement: Barcodes, QR codes and GTIN declarations are permitted in addition to text.
fix_hint: Ensure QR code encodes valid product GTIN or URL.

title_en: Dimensions for textiles, sheets and container type goods
title_hi: कपड़ा, शीट और कंटेनर प्रकार के सामान के आयाम
requirement: Dimensions (length, width, usable size) required for textiles, sheets & containers.
fix_hint: Declare dimensions in cm or m (e.g., 2m x 1.5m).

title_en: Exemptions for goods under other statutory laws (FSSAI/Drugs)
title_hi: अन्य वैधानिक कानूनों (एफएसएसएआई/दवाओं) के तहत छूट
requirement: For food and drugs, LMPC font rules apply only to Net Qty, MRP, Expiry and Consumer Care.
fix_hint: Comply with FSSAI or D&C font rules for non-LMPC fields.
